Period.name: Period
Period.definition: Indicates that the undertaking is automatically extendable and the period of extension.

FinalExpiryDate.name: Final Expiry Date
FinalExpiryDate.definition: Final expiry date after which the undertaking will no longer be subject to automatic extension.

NonExtensionNotification.name: Non Extension Notification
NonExtensionNotification.definition: Details related to the notification of the end of the period for notification of non-extension of the expiry date.
